bias.zh: 偏空 · 自 200 日均线反弹

read.en: Bloom Energy rose 2.2% on Oct 19 to $226.22 but faded from an open of $233.23 to close near the day's low of $224.20. It is below its falling 5-day ($237.3), 10-day ($258.9), falling 100-day ($251.1) and 30-day ($268.9) averages and above the rising 200-day ($217.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($276.8), and RSI is 38.6.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月19日上涨 2.2%，收于 $226.22，但自 $233.23 开盘后回落，收盘接近当日低点 $224.20。股价位于下行的 5 日（$237.3）、10 日（$258.9）、下行的 100 日（$251.1）和 30 日均线（$268.9）下方，位于上行的 200 日均线（$217.0）上方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$276.8），RSI 为 38.6。

read.en: The bounce held the 200-day average and the Oct 15 low ($215.1), but the $230 June pivot capped the day's high of $233.50. Resistance is $230, then $237.3 (5-day) and $251 (100-day, Sep 24 low $251.3). Support is $215–217, then $197.5 (Sep 1 low) and $186 (Aug 24 low). A close below $215 would open $197.5; a close back above $230 would target $237.
read.zh: 反弹守住 200 日均线和 10月15日低点（$215.1），但 $230 的 6 月转折点压制了当日 $233.50 的高点。阻力为 $230，其次 $237.3（5 日均线）和 $251（100 日均线，9月24日低点 $251.3）。支撑为 $215–217，其次 $197.5（9月1日低点）和 $186（8月24日低点）。若收盘跌破 $215，下一目标看 $197.5；若重新收于 $230 上方，则看向 $237。
